entities.name: Build & fixture tooling
entities.responsibility: Repo-level generators that rebuild gitignored wasm-pack output and a seeded stress scene before check, build, and dev.

entities.name: scripts/build-wasm.mjs
entities.responsibility: Invokes wasm-pack to build crates/atlas-wasm into pkg/ (profiling, release, or debug).

entities.name: scripts/generate-stress.mjs
entities.responsibility: Writes a deterministic seeded N-node stress scene under fixtures/renderer/.

entities.name: mulberry32
entities.responsibility: Seeded PRNG so identical --nodes/--edges/--seed arguments rebuild a byte-identical stress scene.
